inputs.text: They’re tightening the same trap in stages: first “F*** Joe Biden!” gets softened into “Let’s go Brandon!”, then even that is treated as a threat. Now the two Michigan brothers are taking the fight to the U.S. Supreme Court, while officials dress up control as “protecting students.” This isn’t just about a dress code—it’s about institutions deciding which dissent people are allowed to see, and using safety as cover whenever they want to silence it.
